bin.headline: This Monday, 3 August — recycling and garden waste.

events.title: Cricket: 1st XI at home to Moreton-in-Marsh
events.body: The Lenches 1st XI host Moreton-in-Marsh at The Lenches on Saturday afternoon, with the 2nd XI away at Elmley Castle. Spectators warmly welcome for village cricket in one of the county's most scenic settings.

events.title: Cricket: midweek Evesham Derby v Offenham
events.body: The Lenches face local neighbours Offenham CC in a Wednesday-evening Evesham Derby, hoping to build on a recent midweek win over Fladbury.

events.title: Free open-air cinema: How to Train Your Dragon — Lenches Amphitheatre
events.body: A free family afternoon screening of the 2010 animated adventure (PG). Gates 4pm, film 5pm; the tearoom and bar are open and pre-ordering food is recommended.

events.title: Sunset cinema: Good Morning, Vietnam — Lenches Amphitheatre
events.body: A free evening screening of the 1987 Robin Williams classic (15), chosen by public vote. Gates 7.30pm, film 8.30pm; bring a rug or chairs.

events.title: Pershore Plum Festival: Plum Fayre Day — Pershore
events.body: The grand finale of the month-long Plum Festival, with the historic market town given over to stalls, food and family entertainment across the August bank holiday Monday.

events.title: Inter-Generation Tennis Funday — Lenches Tennis Club
events.body: A fun, all-ages tennis day in memory of Rod Stroud, open to everyone — no club membership needed. Any two people with an age gap can pair up; barbecue, cakes, drinks and prizes, with the emphasis firmly on fun. To take part, email lenchestc@gmail.com.

events.title: Sherlock Holmes and the Mystery of the Governor's Nose — Lenches Amphitheatre
events.body: Jenny Wren Productions bring an outdoor Sherlock Holmes mystery to the amphitheatre. Gates 1pm, performance 2.30–4.30pm.

events.title: Unmasked: The Magic of Angus Baskerville — The Lenches Club
events.body: Magic Circle magician and mentalist Angus Baskerville brings his hit show to the Club — jaw-dropping illusions, mind-reading and warm storytelling drawn from his own experience of autism and ADHD. 7.30–9pm, a show for all ages.

eventsFootnote: Weekly regulars: yoga at Abbots Morton Village Hall on Mondays (9.45am), Lenches Tennis Club cardio on Tuesdays (6.30pm), tai chi at Abbots Morton on Wednesdays (10am), and candlelight yoga at Rous Lench Village Hall on Thursdays (6.30pm). Encompass are also running children's tennis and multi-sport camps at the Tennis Club every Wednesday and Thursday through the school holidays. Also on this week: a free junior tennis taster session on 21 Aug (5.30pm), and at the Club — Cash Bingo on 21 Aug and Glo Quiz on 22 Aug.

news.title: Six weeks of roadworks at Pinvin
news.body: Main Street in Pinvin is closed until 28 August while the gas mains are upgraded — worth allowing extra time if you head that way towards Pershore or Worcester.

news.title: Scarecrow Festival raises £1,400 for charity
news.body: Evesham's annual Scarecrow Festival at Hampton Ferry drew big crowds last weekend, with a Rotary duck race, live music and a scarecrow competition raising £1,400 for Muscular Dystrophy UK.

news.title: Cricket club: new players welcome
news.body: Players of all ages and abilities are wanted, whether experienced, returning or brand new. Contact Venky on 07442 772470 or Charlie on 07775 660065.

notices.title: Newsletter deadline
notices.body: Got something for next week? Send it to website@thelenches.org.uk by the end of Wednesday.
